description: The Inventory Value report remembers the category a user picked. If that category later stops existing in the data, the report keeps applying it, so it opens showing nothing with no explanation and no visible filter to clear.
steps: Choose any category in the Category filter, so the choice is saved.

Make that saved choice invalid: change the stored category to one that does not exist in the data. This was done with the identifier 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000, which matches no category in this organisation.
Reload the report. This was seen with Locations Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310 and the date range This Month, which holds 5,657 rows before the change.
current:
The report loads with no error, but the invalid category is still there in the saved settings and is still being applied, so the table comes back with no rows at all — down from 5,657.

The date range, locations, columns and sort were all restored correctly in the same load, so the restoring itself is running.
expected: A saved category that no longer exists in the data is quietly dropped on load, and the report opens on its normal full list.
source: Restore is defensive: a saved value that is no longer valid falls back to that setting's default rather than breaking the view. A saved category or vendor no longer present in the data is dropped.
